hypothesis: v2 over-predicted trees because model height noise lifts lawns above 2 m. LangSplat's SAM + CLIP image features separate trees, grass and roofs by appearance, so v3 decides trees vs grass without height and uses height only to separate raised from flat surfaces. No OSM and no NDVI: the method needs only the release's RGB training views.
independence: Prompts, fusion and rules are fixed here before any v3 score is computed. They are not blind: v1/v2 error patterns on JAX_068 were already known. The v2 thresholds 2.5 m (building) and DFC mapping are reused unchanged.
grid: DFC2019 JAX_068 truth grid (UTM 17N, 0.5 m, 512 x 512), as in v1/v2
surface: identical to v1/v2 (pipeline.semantics.top_surface): rendered-depth top, 5th-percentile ground in 25.5 m, hag = top - ground

features.tool: LangSplat preprocess.py (SAM ViT-B sam_vit_b_01ec64.pth + OpenCLIP ViT-B-16 laion2b_s34b_b88k), quality settings of the earlier LangSplat pilot
features.views: the 19 training views of artifacts/imagery/pilot-19v/skyfall (transforms_train.json); the 2015-05-02 holdout is never used
features.level_weights_note: Same weights as the earlier LangSplat pilot's pixel_scores; levels without a segment at a pixel are dropped and the rest renormalised

building: a building roof seen from above
shadow: a dark shadow on the ground

scoring.prototype: mean of the L2-normalised CLIP text embeddings of a class's three prompts, renormalised
scoring.segment: softmax over the nine classes of 100 x cosine(segment feature, prototype)
scoring.cell: each cell's top-surface point (gap-filled height) projected through each training camera (bundle-adjusted pinhole, deskewed image); nearest pixel at mask resolution; median over visible views, then argmax
scoring.visibility: inside the image, inside the deskew coverage mask, covered by a segment, and not occluded: camera depth <= minimum depth of all top-surface points in the 3 x 3 pixel neighbourhood + 1.0 m

rules: building -> building if hag >= 2.5 m, else ground
road, car -> road if hag < 2.5 m, else unknown
pavement, soil, shadow -> ground if hag < 2.5 m, else unknown
water -> water if hag < 2.5 m, else unknown
no top surface or fewer than 2 visible views -> unknown
classes.clip_only_diagnostic: same argmax without height: building, vegetation, grass, road (road, car), ground (pavement, soil, shadow), water

splats: as v1/v2 (pipeline.semantics.splat_classes); the wall rule uses cells classified building instead of OSM footprints

evaluation.scored_cells: truth not 65 and not 17; geometry as built (no registration shift)
evaluation.strict: our unknown cells count as incorrect
evaluation.headline: the height rules above; the CLIP-only variant is reported as a diagnostic and cannot pass

rule: Prompts, weights, fusion, rules and targets are fixed before any v3 comparison with DFC2019 and are not changed afterwards.
result: training/semantics/v3-jax068-evaluation.json: FAILED all three targets (overall accuracy 0.251, building IoU 0.001, vegetation IoU 0.067). The 'shadow' class won 226,534 of 243,691 cells with evidence.
